tokens.styling: Style (fg/bg/Modifier) + the Stylize trait ("x".red().bold().on_blue()); Span -> Line -> Text; ratatui-macros for span!/line!/text!
tokens.layout: Cassowary constraint solver: Layout::new(dir, [Constraint...]).split(area); Length/Percentage/Ratio/Min/Max/Fill; Flex for leftover space; recomputed every draw

components.name: Clear
components.when_to_use: blank a Rect to render popups/modals over content

components.name: input / editor / tree
components.when_to_use: single-line input, multi-line editor, tree — core deliberately omits these

rules: Immediate-mode: YOU own the loop and state. Generate the full harness — raw mode, alt screen, terminal.draw each frame, event loop, quit.
Restore the terminal on panic: ratatui::init()/restore() + color-eyre panic hook (near-mandatory) — else a crash leaves the terminal broken.
Store ListState/TableState/ScrollbarState in the app struct (not per-frame) — creating fresh state each frame resets selection/scroll.
On Windows filter KeyEventKind::Press (double events). Async = tokio + EventStream + mpsc/select! into one loop; never block draw.
Ratatui is pre-1.0 (0.x breaks on minor) — pin the exact version. Want Elm structure over it -> tui-realm.
Never scaffold tui-rs (dead — Ratatui is its successor).
